# CAT corridor route polylines

Generated by Navi's own car router (`navi-ffi` `plan-cat-corridors`) on the
Ostlandet OSM PBF (`DATA_SOURCE=real_pbf`), not great circles.

| File | Route | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `espa_dombas_e6.polyline` | Espa → Dombås | E6 corridor; ~242 km |
| `espa_litjfossen_rv3_skansen.polyline` | Espa → Litjfossen | Via Skansen rundkjøring (waypoint); Rv 3 / Østerdalen |

Format: Navi `lon,lat;lon,lat;…` (same as `CorridorRouteResult.route_polyline`).

Regenerate (needs local PBF + elevation):

```bash
CAT_PACK_DIR=/path/to/ostlandet-pack \
CAT_ELEV_DIR=/path/to/elevation \
CAT_FORCE_PBF=1 \
cargo run -p navi-ffi --bin plan-cat-corridors --release
```
